refrozenFrom.reason: render-pdf command: isolated Hancom render entry point (rendering/cli.py, rendering/__main__.py) for callers that cannot install [oracle] beside their own core pin; mac_session exposes the shared desktop lock path it already used. Historical core source receipts unchanged.

renderPdfRefrozenFrom.reason: render-pdf on a shared desktop: the input is checked as an HWPX package before Hancom sees it, SIGTERM unwinds the render (osascript killed, owned document closed, staging removed, desktop lock released), and non-finite numbers are usage errors. Historical core source receipts unchanged.

refusedAlertRefrozenFrom.reason: A document Hancom refuses to open: the Mac render reports the alert it dismissed (MacHancomOracle.last_refusal), render-pdf ends as hancom-refused and the worker as HANCOM_REFUSED (mac_session.HancomRefusedError). Historical core source receipts unchanged.

windowsTempStagingRefrozenFrom.reason: Windows renders stage each document in a private folder under the user's temporary folder, where Hancom opens and saves without its file-access approval prompt, and move only a finished PDF to the requested path (WindowsComOracle._stage_jobs, _promote_file); the packaged scripts register a file-path check module with its module type FilePathCheckDLL (#150). Historical core source receipts unchanged.

windowsRefreshRefrozenFrom.reason: WindowsComOracle.refresh_document: Hancom opens a copy in a private temporary folder, lays it out and saves it as HWPX there, and the original is replaced only by a complete package (#152); the render and refresh share one backend runner (_run_jobs). Historical core source receipts unchanged.
